title: The four-factor diagonal orientation commutes with etale correspondences
statement: Fix P and finite-type k-target Y. Let f:X→Y and g:Z→Y be separated quasi-compact smooth maps of pure dimension d, with Noetherian schemes and compactifications. Choose normalized diagonal charts C and E on the same affine target open V. Let j:U→X and v:U→Z be separated quasi-compact etale maps of finite type, U Noetherian, v g=j f, and both composites compactifiable. For any open O of U and actual lifts jO:O→f^{-1}V and vO:O→g^{-1}V commuting with inclusions, the two local inverse DNC orientations agree under the specified pullback comparisons, the canonical finite Tate comparisons for any normalized t, and the source-etale dualizing locality for any normalized compact-support datum N. The attached Lean equation specifies each endpoint and conjugation. No affine counit, P1 datum or orientation realization is assumed.

proof.text: On self-products first base-change the diagonal along the etale map and then restrict the other factor. Remove the complementary clopen components of the centre. The conormal map fixes the ordered differences and induces the coefficientwise Rees map. DNC family normalization and uniqueness give the delta square.
Choose vector models and common local frames. Apply BetaNormalized and vector integration base change. Linear trace invariance eliminates dependence on the frames and gives the beta square.

Paste the self-product and section squares for alpha and the target-open square for rho. The canonical sum-extension counit gives the locality maps. Multiply the four equations; site composition and coefficient pullbacks give exactly restrictionAlong. Compare after shifting the rank-one source to the heart and use sheaf-Hom descent. Empty opens and rank zero use zero objects and the empty tensor.

theorem diagonalDncEtaleNaturality (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (C : OrientationRefinement.Chart P f aY d V)
    (E : OrientationRefinement.Chart P g aY d V)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    [HasCompactification (j ≫ f)] [HasCompactification (v ≫ g)]
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    let νU := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let T := OrientationRefinement.pull P O.ι
    let cj := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P j (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O jO hj
    let cv := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P v (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O vO hv
    let a :=
      (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t j (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit (f ≫ aY)) d).hom ≫
      (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t v (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit (g ≫ aY)) d).inv
    let b := (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N v g).hom ≫
      (P.diagonalDualizingCongr w).hom ≫ (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N j f).inv
    T.map (νU.map a) ≫
        (cv.app (P.diagonalTwistEtale Z d)).inv ≫
        (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).map
          (OrientationCounit.localInverse P d g aY V E).hom ≫
        (cv.app (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing g)).hom ≫ T.map (νU.map b) =
      (cj.app (P.diagonalTwistEtale X d)).inv ≫
        (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).map
          (OrientationCounit.localInverse P d f aY V C).hom ≫
        (cj.app (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f)).hom
